A_rear_nacelle.note: 8 mm PTFE lip seal + 608-2RS in the nacelle cap; motor's own bearings inside p0

B_hub_drum.note: 15 mm PTFE lip seal + 2 x 6702-2RS (v3.1 drum)

boost_clamp.note: boost MPPT into a 12.8 V LiFePO4 (Genasun GVB-8-Li-14.2V class, 5 V minimum input); above the battery voltage the boost cannot regulate and the bus clamps at V_bat + drops

buckboost.note: 4-60 V buck-boost with input-voltage (MPPT) regulation (LT8390/LT8705 class module); regulates over the whole 0.4-2 m/s range

direct.note: rectifier straight into the 12.8 V LiFePO4 (14.4 V bus): no converter, no MPPT

ideal.note: lossless converter with unlimited voltage range: upper bound only

schottky.note: MBR10100-class Schottky bridge, Vf = 0.30 + 0.20 I (V), two diodes conduct

synchronous.note: ideal-diode MOSFET bridge (LT4320 class), ~30 mV drop
